best: Every block sits in a titled frame with a plain-language note giving the design values, and the four-switch stage, bucks, dividers and RC sense filters are drawn in clean, textbook form with decoupling at their pins.
worst: The Cells sheet has a 'Cell and load wires' block and a test-point block of wire pads tied only by labels, cut off from the circuits they serve, and the protection-FET stage puts the pack power path on a source rail under the FETs rather than reading as a clear series path.

On the USB sheets, the charger's HIDRV/LODRV/SW and sense nets and the TPD6S300 C_CC inputs reach the power stage and connector only through net-name stubs, so following the hot path means matching labels across blocks; stacked hidden-pin numbers (U401 pin 15, U405 GND/NC pins) also clutter the symbol edges.
Space use is uneven: the 3V3 and MCU sheets leave large empty areas while the USB sheet packs five blocks densely into small text.
